pages.title: Getting Started & Configuration
pages.purpose: Setup instructions, environment variables (.env), dependency management (pyproject.toml / uv.lock), MCP client configuration (mcp-claude-config.json), and how to run the system for the first time.

pages.title: System Architecture & Data Flow
pages.purpose: End-to-end data flow from Feishu IM/Docs ingestion through detection, episode management, LLM extraction, memory graph storage, and MCP exposure. Describes the detector-engine-storage pattern and key design decisions.

pages.title: Feishu IM Detector
pages.purpose: Details the LarkIMDetector and its two modes (polling and WebSocket), the EnhancedDetector heuristic scoring pipeline, anti-signal filtering, and burst-mode polling logic.

pages.title: Episode Management
pages.purpose: Explains how individual messages are buffered into Episodes by EpisodeManager, the time-gap and semantic-threshold boundary detection, the run_episode_check_loop reaper, and how episodes are dispatched to the MemoryEngine.

pages.title: MemoryGraph (In-Memory Index)
pages.purpose: Deep dive into MemoryGraph: five internal indices, DecisionNode schema, hot score algorithm, conflict detection via CONFLICTS_WITH relations, dirty-node tracking, and the GitReader protocol.

pages.title: Git Storage Backend
pages.purpose: Explains GitStorage CRUD operations, the decision branch-per-record strategy, file format (YAML frontmatter + Markdown body), commit message conventions, GitCLI wrapper, git_format serialization, and auto-push configuration.

pages.title: Hypergraph Structure & Retrieval
pages.purpose: Covers the four-layer hypergraph (Decision L0, Fact L1, Episode L2, Topic L3), HypergraphBuilder, HierarchicalRetriever (BM25 + vector fusion), and the graph/builder and graph/retrieval modules.

pages.title: MemoryEngine Lifecycle
pages.purpose: Details MemoryEngine initialization, the detector loop, sync loop (dirty-node flushing), semantic reconnection of episodes, deduplication via embedding+reranker+LLM judge, conflict detection, and graceful shutdown.

pages.title: DecisionNode & Mutation Model
pages.purpose: Documents the DecisionNode Pydantic schema (all fields, roles, status state machine), DecisionMutation command types, and PipelineEngine.apply_mutation dispatch logic.

pages.title: MCP Tool Reference
pages.purpose: Comprehensive reference for all 34 MCP tools grouped by category: Query tools, Writing tools, LLM-assisted tools, and Git/system tools.

pages.title: MCP Server Deployment
pages.purpose: Explains how to launch the MCP server via `uv run`, configure it in Claude Desktop or OpenClaw, required environment variables, and the stdio transport protocol.

pages.title: PushEngine & Scheduling
pages.purpose: Details PushEngine triggers (CREATE, CONFLICT, DECISION_UPDATE, SCHEDULED_DAILY, etc.), the hot score decay/increment system, daily/weekly summary loops, multi-channel dispatch, and error degradation.

pages.title: Card Renderer
pages.purpose: Covers CardRenderer output formats (Feishu interactive card JSON, Markdown), decision card layout, conflict card comparative view, and daily summary format.

pages.title: Evaluator & Scenarios
pages.purpose: Documents the ExtractionEvaluator (EvalRunner), the eval_data/test_data.txt simulation mode, the decision_extraction QA dataset (12 scenarios, 170 samples), evaluation dimensions, and the eval report schema.
